messages:
Sophie Chen: quick heads-up 180 12 — about 80 EU trial tenants are seeing prolonged onboarding queueing and slow embedding writes since this morning's schema rollout. mostly small trials in eu-west-1. need a short customer note and a list of who to offer credits to.
Liam Patel: ack. any immediate mitigation and ETA? renewals will want a list for outreach.
Anya Kuznetsova: short tech note for CS: the schema migration introduced an unexpected index write pattern that caused backpressure on our embeddings write path. worker pods fell behind and the ingest queue grew; some requests timed out and were retried, causing duplicate work and longer latencies. mitigation: we reverted the schema change, bumped ingestion worker concurrency for the affected pool, and cleared the stalled queue. were monitoring; initial stabilization looks like 1-3 hours.
Maya O'Neill: copied. can we give CS a 1-line RCA and a one-line recommended action to paste into emails?
Anya Kuznetsova: RCA (one-line): a schema rollout changed embedding write behavior and created write-side backpressure, leading to queued onboarding jobs and intermittent timeouts. Recommended action (one-line): enable the hosted ingest fallback in the Console or use the API to switch to hosted-ingest for immediate throughput relief.
Grace Li: drafted short customer-facing blurb (two lines):
"Hi
Were investigating delays and intermittent failures for some onboarding and embedding jobs in EU. Weve applied mitigations and recommend enabling 'hosted-ingest' fallback in the Console to restore throughput immediately. Well follow up with an RCA and compensation details if you were impacted.

















- Redwood CS"
Carlos Rivera: pls include quick Console steps so customers can self-serve. reduces tickets.
Grace Li: Console steps (short copy you can paste):
1) Console > Onboarding > Jobs > Routing/Fallback
2) Toggle: "Enable hosted-ingest fallback" -> choose "hosted-ingest"
3) Save
API snippet (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments/DEPLOY_ID/routing" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"policy":"hosted-ingest","priority":["eu-west-1","hosted-ingest"]}'
```
Sophie Chen: good. Carlos, please send the short blast + link to office hours. add: "If you already see normal behavior, no action required." Also offer a one-time credit if >20% job failures.
Carlos Rivera: draft email below 10k for send?
Subject: Update: temporary onboarding & embedding delays in EU
Body: Hi ,
Were reaching out about temporary delays and intermittent failures affecting some onboarding and embedding jobs in the EU. We reverted a schema change and applied mitigations; enabling the hosted ingest fallback in the Console will restore throughput immediately. If your jobs failed or were delayed, reply to this message and well offer a one-time credit based on the impact. For live help, join office hours: https://redwood.ai/office-hours. Full RCA to follow within 48 hours.
Sophie Chen: send. add a tracking tag in the outreach sheet: "impact_pct" and "credit_approved".
Carlos Rivera: adding columns now and flagging any trial with >20% failures as high-priority for renewals outreach.
Liam Patel: renewals note: prioritize any accounts with scheduled renewals in 30 days and >10% SLA hits.
Anya Kuznetsova: postmortem items: timeline of schema rollout, exact index behavior, why detection didn't trigger earlier, and the queued metrics. I'll have eng RCA draft in ~24h.
statusbot: Incident posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-eu-ingest-backpressure-2026  Mitigation applied; monitoring.
Grace Li: Ill publish a KB with screenshots for the Console toggle and paste the curl example into the follow-up message. will link in the customer email.
Sophie Chen: thanks all. we'll reconvene after monitoring shows steady state. if anything degrades again, escalate to the on-call infra lead.
